notes: In-app sign-in release. The native in-app PKCE path previously could fail with 'Gateway HTTP 400' for three independent reasons, all now fixed in the client: (1) /api/status returns auth_providers as a flat name list (["basic"]), not a list of {name} objects; (2) the hermes_session_pkce broker cookie is set on a 302 hop of /auth/native/authorize and OkHttp does not auto-follow cross-origin redirects, so the redirect chain is followed manually; (3) password-login with the broker returns HTTP 200 + JSON body {ok,next:"...?code=..."}, so the auth code is parsed out of the next URL. Server-side the new basic-auth password is accepted (POST /auth/password-login -> 200).
